mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where aging, family, and all the odd little moments of daily life come together—sometimes making us laugh, sometimes making us pause. Have you ever noticed how the most ordinary days can suddenly feel extraordinary, or how a family gathering can swing from hilarious to bittersweet in a heartbeat? That’s exactly the world David Sedaris invites us into with his collection, Calypso. Picture a beach house on the Carolina coast—a place where siblings gather, old stories resurface, and the ticking of time turns both funny and a little bit sad. In Sedaris’s hands, those familiar family rituals and everyday absurdities become something intimate and unexpectedly moving. Together, we’ll explore how laughter and vulnerability can walk side by side. We’ll see how the challenges of health, the weight of memory, and the quirks of family life can reveal what really matters. As we dive into these stories, get ready to catch glimpses of your own life reflected in the tapestry Sedaris weaves—where heartbreak and hilarity aren’t all that far apart. Let’s discover together how we cope with change, hold onto fleeting joys, and maybe even find comfort in the shared, messy beauty of growing older. So, if you’re ready to laugh, reflect, and maybe see the familiar in a whole new light, you’re in exactly the right place.
